quote.text: There’s an old saying that victory has 100 fathers and defeat is an orphan…
quote.author: John F. Kennedy, 21 April 1961, accepting sole responsibility for the Bay of Pigs

macro.title: What It Means For VWRA, Global Bonds, Gold & BTC

stories.headline: Unknown projectiles sank Singapore’s GFS Pride; Iran blames a naval mine
stories.dek: The Maritime and Port Authority called the 13 October strike unprovoked and a breach of international law. All 21 crew got off. It named nobody.

stories.headline: Singapore’s central PSI hit 219, past the Haze Act’s threshold
stories.dek: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong says the government is working out which companies are responsible. In twelve years it has never fined one.

stories.headline: Japan will fund two New York fabs for GlobalFoundries to run
stories.dek: Tokyo provides up to $21bn; Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick takes about 4% of the operator. The first fab is due online in 2029.

stories.headline: Italy’s Fantini says only the cartridge and aerator are bought in
stories.dek: The Italian house has made taps at Pella since 1947. The two parts that move, wear and touch your water are the two it does not make.

stories.headline: Microsoft ships the Surface Laptop Ultra, unlisted on its Singapore site
stories.dek: The first NVIDIA RTX Spark laptop starts at US$2,599.99. Apple opens iPhone Duo pre-orders here at 8pm tonight, from S$3,099.

stories.headline: MING and Massena LAB sold out 125 watches on Wednesday morning
stories.dek: The 57.09 “Secret Honey” went on sale at 9am New York time at CHF 7,250. Its maker’s page now says sold out and also quotes eight to twelve weeks.

stories.headline: NME reviewed Fontaines D.C.’s Dopamine Chamber four days before release
stories.dek: The five-star NME verdict was filed four days before release, and a Metacritic score of 84 was circulating by Thursday.

stories.headline: JAMA Pediatrics reports one in six US adolescents screening positive
stories.dek: The JAMA Pediatrics study surveyed 15,730 twelve- to twenty-year-olds. Four in ten of the worst affected received no treatment in a year.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Kospi Circuit Breaker
stories.headline: Korea’s Kospi fell 7.57% into a circuit breaker
stories.dek: Samsung lost 9.5% and SK hynix 11.1% on 15 October. Hours later the US ten-year fell 11 basis points and the S&P closed up 0.26%.

stories.headline: Volunteers gave Britain 5,570 unpaid hours of cave rescue in 2025
stories.dek: Sport caving has 8,500 members in America and 154 clubs in Britain. Its characteristic emergency is not a fall but a cold, lost party.

stories.headline: Exercise alone did not cut cognitive risk in Whitehall II
stories.dek: The Whitehall II cohort gives a risk ratio of 0.98 for meeting the guideline. Stacked with diet, no smoking and four vascular targets, it falls to 0.86.

stories.headline: Esplanade runs 29 free shows; Tokyo’s private museums publish no price
stories.dek: Two Singapore festivals and two Tokyo national museums print full tiered fares. Ten of twenty-six listings below give no figure at all.

stories.headline: Taiwan recognised the Siraya in July; 1,336 people have registered
stories.dek: Taiwan’s Council of Indigenous Peoples projected 50,000 in the first year; its own 2022 estimate of plains-Indigenous ancestry was 980,000.
